# certloom_dns_solver (Resource)

A DNS-01 solver that agents use to answer ACME challenges for the listed zones.

With `credential = "stored"` the DNS provider credential is passed in the write-only `secret_wo` argument. certloom seals it to the assigned agents; it is never written to plan or state and never returned by the API. Bump `secret_wo_version` to rotate it. With `credential = "ambient"` (plugins only) the agent uses its host's own cloud identity and no secret is sent.

Only the secret and the agent assignments can change in place; any other change replaces the solver.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "cloudflare_api_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

data "certloom_agent" "web01" {
  name = "web-01"
}

resource "certloom_dns_solver" "cloudflare" {
  name              = "cloudflare"
  provider_type     = "cloudflare"
  zones             = ["example.com"]
  credential        = "stored"
  secret_wo         = jsonencode({ api_token = var.cloudflare_api_token })
  secret_wo_version = 1 # bump to rotate
  agent_ids         = [data.certloom_agent.web01.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential` (String) `stored` (secret in `secret_wo`) or `ambient` (the agent host's identity; plugins only).
- `name` (String) Unique solver name.
- `provider_type` (String) `rfc2136`, `cloudflare` or `plugin`.
- `zones` (List of String) DNS zones the solver may write, lowercase without a trailing dot.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `agent_ids` (Set of String) Agents allowed to use this solver (`data.certloom_agent.<name>.id`).
- `config` (String) Non-secret provider settings as JSON (`jsonencode`), for example the RFC 2136 server and TSIG key name.
- `plugin` (String) Absolute path of the solver plugin on the agent hosts (`plugin` only).
- `plugin_sha256` (String) Hex SHA-256 of the plugin binary; agents refuse a plugin that does not match.
- `secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Provider credential as a JSON object of strings, for example `jsonencode({api_token = var.cloudflare_token})`. Write-only: never stored in plan or state. Required on create when `credential` is `stored`.
- `secret_wo_version` (Number) Change this number to send a new `secret_wo`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier assigned by certloom.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by id, as shown by the certloom CLI or API.
terraform import certloom_dns_solver.example <id>
```
